description: Split the runner workflow executor (packages/runner/src/runtime/executor.ts, ~1106 lines) along its concern boundaries by extracting the branch-stability invariant and the worktree-cleanliness invariant into dedicated single-responsibility modules, with the executor converging to an orchestration entry. Behavior-preserving refactor; execution/fault-tolerance/scheduling semantics and the runner↔server contract are unchanged.

tasks.title: Extract shared git-probe helper and branch-stability invariant module
tasks.spec: specs/runner-executor-structure/spec.md#分支稳定性不变式位于独立单一职责模块
tasks.description: Establish the shared git-probe injection point and extract the branch-stability invariant into a dedicated single-responsibility module. Create `packages/runner/src/runtime/git-probe.ts` (~30 lines) holding the `GitRunner` type, the single mutable-let `git` runner (initialized to `defaultGit`), and the `setExecutorGitRunnerForTest` stub — both invariants will share this one injection point. Create `packages/runner/src/runtime/branch-stability.ts` (~180 lines) with stateless functions `checkBranchStability` / `readCurrentBranch` / `expectedWorkspaceBranch` / `branchInvariantViolationFailure` / `attachBranchStabilityEvidence` / `branchStabilityToJson` and types `BranchStabilityEvidence` / `BranchInvariantViolationEvidence` / `CurrentBranchResult`; `checkBranchStability` returns `{ kind: "ok"; evidence } | { kind: "violation"; result }` with signature unchanged from the current executor.ts:183-186. executor.ts stops inlining branch stability: it imports these symbols and the start/end boundary checks (executor.ts:134-137 / 145-148) become single delegated calls; `attachBranchStabilityEvidence` is imported for the executor's evidence-stack assembly on non-completed and worktree-failure branches (executor.ts:143/152/154). The git `let` and its references (readCurrentBranch at executor.ts:924) now resolve via git-probe.ts. Update import paths in `executor-branch-stability.spec.ts` and `workspace-prepare-workflow.spec.ts` (which import the git-runner stub) — signatures are unchanged, only the import source moves. Per design Decisions 1, 3, 4.
acceptanceCriteria: `packages/runner/src/runtime/git-probe.ts` exists and exports a single shared `git` runner, the `GitRunner` type, and `setExecutorGitRunnerForTest` with a signature identical to today; executor.ts no longer declares a local `let git`.

`packages/runner/src/runtime/branch-stability.ts` exists and exports `checkBranchStability`, `readCurrentBranch`, `expectedWorkspaceBranch`, `branchInvariantViolationFailure`, `attachBranchStabilityEvidence`, `branchStabilityToJson` and the three evidence/result types; all are stateless functions with no cross-call instance state.

executor.ts contains no inlined multi-branch decision tree (detached/nonGit/error/mismatch) and no inlined git rev-parse probing for branch detection; the start and end boundary checks are single delegated calls to branch-stability.ts exports.

`executor-branch-stability.spec.ts` and `workspace-prepare-workflow.spec.ts` pass after updating only their import paths (no assertion or scenario weakening); the shared git-runner stub is patched from git-probe.ts and both invariants observe the same patch.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner` passes.
`packages/runner/src/runtime/worktree-cleanup.ts` is untouched (pure-data module stays independent).
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/runtime/git-probe.ts and packages/runner/src/runtime/branch-stability.ts created; executor.ts delegating branch-stability checks; executor-branch-stability + workspace-prepare-workflow specs green.
tasks.notes: git-probe.ts is the shared dependency both invariant modules consume; bundle it here as the foundational prerequisite refactor (design Decision 1). Resolve the shared small-utils question (safeParseJson/errorMessage/isNotFoundError) per design Open Questions: keep in executor, have branch-stability import or self-supply as needed — do not create a fourth file for 3-line helpers. Do NOT extract recovery or any post-side-effect code in this task.

tasks.title: Extract worktree-cleanliness invariant module (cleanup loop + stale-index-lock recovery)
tasks.spec: specs/runner-executor-structure/spec.md#工作树清洁不变式位于独立单一职责模块
tasks.description: Extract the worktree-cleanliness invariant into `packages/runner/src/runtime/worktree-enforcement.ts` (~320 lines), importing `git` from git-probe.ts (from T-001) and `isAgentBackedTask` / `resolveMaxCleanupAttempts` / `buildCleanupWith` / `WorktreeSnapshot` from the existing pure-data `worktree-cleanup.ts`. Migrate the bounded agent cleanup loop (`enforceCleanWorktree` / `runAgentCleanupAttempt` / `readWorktreeSnapshot`), the stale git index lock recovery state machine (`recoverStaleIndexLock` / `defaultLockHolderProbe` / `resolveStaleIndexLockMs` / constant `DEFAULT_STALE_INDEX_LOCK_MS`), evidence/failure constructors (`dirtyWorktreeFailure` / `gitIndexLockFailure` / `formatDirtyWorktreeSummary` / `worktreeProbeFailure` / `parseFileList`), the `WorktreeProbeError` class, types `DirtyWorktreeEvidence` / `GitIndexLockRecovery`, and the shared pure helper `mergeCleanupCount`. Migrate the `setCleanupAgentActionForTest` (+ `CleanupAgentAction` type) and `setExecutorLockHolderProbeForTest` (+ `LockHolderProbe` type) stubs into this module with signatures unchanged. Per design Decision 2, sink the `WorktreeProbeError` catch into `enforceCleanWorktree` itself: `readWorktreeSnapshot` is the only throw source inside that try block (readCurrentBranch folds errors into CurrentBranchResult.error, it does not throw), so `enforceCleanWorktree` internally catches `WorktreeProbeError` and returns `worktreeProbeFailure(work, error)`; executor's outer try/catch drops its `instanceof WorktreeProbeError` branch (executor.ts:159-161). Per design Decision 5, `enforceCleanWorktree` receives `cleanupAction`, a `baseContext` factory, and `contextParts` as positional params from the executor (so the module does not reverse-import executor); `runAgentCleanupAttempt` still receives the baseContext-derived context via these params. Update import paths in `executor-cleanup.spec.ts` and `issue-112-regression.spec.ts` (and the branch-stability spec's cleanup/lock-probe imports) — only import source changes. Per design Decisions 2, 3, 5.
acceptanceCriteria: `packages/runner/src/runtime/worktree-enforcement.ts` exists and exports `enforceCleanWorktree`, `runAgentCleanupAttempt`, `readWorktreeSnapshot`, `recoverStaleIndexLock`, `defaultLockHolderProbe`, `resolveStaleIndexLockMs`, `dirtyWorktreeFailure`, `gitIndexLockFailure`, `formatDirtyWorktreeSummary`, `worktreeProbeFailure`, `parseFileList`, `WorktreeProbeError`, types `DirtyWorktreeEvidence` / `GitIndexLockRecovery`, and constant `DEFAULT_STALE_INDEX_LOCK_MS`.

executor.ts contains no inlined cleanup loop, no lsof/lock-holder probe, and no stale-index-lock recovery state machine; the post-task worktree-cleanliness check is a single delegated call to `enforceCleanWorktree`.

`WorktreeProbeError` is caught inside `enforceCleanWorktree` and mapped to `worktreeProbeFailure`; executor's outer catch no longer references `WorktreeProbeError` and the same probe failure still produces the same `worktreeProbeFailure` result (verified by executor-cleanup probe-failure scenario).
`setCleanupAgentActionForTest` and `setExecutorLockHolderProbeForTest` are defined/exported from worktree-enforcement.ts with byte-identical signatures to today.

`worktree-enforcement.ts` imports `git` from git-probe.ts (the same shared injection point as branch-stability) and imports pure-data symbols from `worktree-cleanup.ts`; it does NOT import executor.ts (no circular dependency). `worktree-cleanup.ts` remains pure-data with no I/O and is not merged.

`executor-cleanup.spec.ts` and `issue-112-regression.spec.ts` pass after updating only import paths (stale-lock budget/timeout semantics and cleanup attempt counts unchanged); the lock-recovery state machine budget/timeout behavior is identical to pre-split.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner` passes.
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/runtime/worktree-enforcement.ts created (cleanup loop + stale-lock recovery + WorktreeProbeError sinking); executor.ts delegating worktree-cleanliness check; executor-cleanup + issue-112-regression specs green.
tasks.notes: Depends on T-001 for the shared git-probe.ts injection point (worktree probing and lock recovery both call the shared `git` runner). Keep `baseContext` in executor and pass it into enforceCleanWorktree (Decision 5) to avoid worktree-enforcement reverse-importing executor. Per design Open Questions, carry `mergeCleanupCount` into this module. Do NOT extract recovery (tryRecovery) or post-side-effects — those stay in executor.

tasks.title: Converge executor to orchestration entry and verify cross-cutting invariants
tasks.spec: specs/runner-executor-structure/spec.md#执行器入口聚焦编排与阶段串联
tasks.description: With both invariant modules extracted (T-001, T-002), finalize executor.ts as the orchestration entry and run the cross-cutting verification that can only be done once both extractions land. Confirm `executeOne` reads as a clean linear pipeline: resolve action → variables → render with → resolve workDir → checkBranchStability(start) → action → normalize → tryRecovery → checkBranchStability(end) → enforceCleanWorktree → captureAndUploadArtifacts → captureDeclaredOutputs → applySetVars, where each invariant is a single function call and no invariant detail is inlined between stages. Ensure the retained concerns stay in executor: orchestration entry (`execute` / `executeOne` / `executeChecks`), workspace resolution (`prepareWorkspace` / `workspaceFromVariables` / `workspaceRoot` / `resolveWorkDir`), post-side-effect thin layers (`captureAndUploadArtifacts` / `applySetVars` / `captureDeclaredOutputs` over artifact-capture/set-vars/output-capture), task-failure recovery (`tryRecovery` / `matchesWhen` / `readRecoveryConfig` / `readAddTasks` / `decrementRecoveryBudget` — retained in-place, NOT extracted, no independent spec), and helpers (`normalize` / `failure` / `baseContext` / `toCheckStatus` / `isCheck` / `resolveWorkspacePath` / `formatUnresolvedError` / `formatCheckUnresolvedError` / `workspaceSetupFailure`). Clean up any residual imports/dead code left by the extractions. Run the full runner test suite unmodified and confirm the recovery path (failure → completed+addTasks, budget decrement, retry-self expansion) behaves identically. Confirm scc shows executor.ts, branch-stability.ts, and worktree-enforcement.ts each out of the runner package complexity front ranks. The only external consumer `runtime/host.ts` still imports `WorkExecutor` unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: `executeOne` method body presents the linear pipeline order above; each invariant stage (branch stability start/end, enforceCleanWorktree) is a single delegated function call with no inlined multi-branch/loop/lock-recovery detail between stages.
`tryRecovery` and its helpers (`matchesWhen` / `readRecoveryConfig` / `readAddTasks` / `decrementRecoveryBudget`) remain inside executor.ts (orchestration entry), NOT extracted to a separate module.

Post-side-effect methods (`captureAndUploadArtifacts` / `applySetVars` / `captureDeclaredOutputs`) remain thin layers over artifact-capture.ts / set-vars.ts / output-capture.ts; their internals are not re-inlined.

`npm test -w packages/runner` passes in full — all per-concern executor specs (branch-stability, worktree-cleanliness, artifact, workspace-boundary, checks verdict) and the issue-112 regression pass unmodified, none weakened/skipped/rewritten.

Recovery path behaves identically to pre-split: failure output matched against recovery config, budget decrement, retry-self expansion to completed+addTasks — verified by the artifact/branch-stability specs that indirectly cover tryRecovery.
Runner↔server work-distribution contract, task scheduling rules, and retry strategy are unchanged; no new execution stages or work-item types introduced.

`scc packages/runner/src/` shows `executor.ts`, `branch-stability.ts`, and `worktree-enforcement.ts` each out of the runner package cyclomatic-complexity front ranks; `executor.ts` line count dropped from ~1106 toward orchestration-entry scale (~350).
`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner` passes; `runtime/host.ts` still imports `WorkExecutor` from the same path.
tasks.output: executor.ts finalized as orchestration entry (~350 lines, linear pipeline); full runner test suite green; scc report confirming all three modules out of complexity front ranks.
tasks.notes: This is the integration/convergence gate: the cross-cutting acceptance criteria (scc across all three modules, full unmodified test suite, recovery-path parity) can only be verified after both invariant extractions land. If executor.ts still exceeds orchestration-entry scale after T-001/T-002, move any remaining evidence/failure constructors that belong to an invariant into its module. Per design testing constraints, all checks use the existing injected fakes — no real git/process/DB.
